_comment: BYOK real-upstream mode. 'shared' holds one real Anthropic account: key is 'env:FID_ANTHROPIC_KEY' (resolved from the environment at boot), so only a placeholder is baked into the measured image — the real key is injected at VM launch via Confidential Space `tee-env-FID_ANTHROPIC_KEY` metadata and never enters git or the image registry. 'cust-vip' stays mock for local testing.
